value.rationale: The 2026 paper explicitly isolates cyclic-shift separation as an extremal automaton-state problem. Determining the first two shift distances exactly for every word length and finite alphabet supplies a natural infinite classification and a sharp state-complexity discontinuity 2-to-3. The proof reveals a structural universal 12-element centralizer witness and extends the classic four-letter lower example to sharpness at all lengths. This is neither a random small slice nor just numerical recomputation. Wider shifts remain open.
